headlines.title: Watch: Spain witnesses first total solar eclipse in 27 years
headlines.description: NBC News’ Raf Sanchez reports on the ground in Spain as crowds revel and cheer at the total solar eclipse taking place during the sunset hour.

headlines.title: Karoline Leavitt to step down as White House press secretary at end of August
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced that White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt will be stepping down from her role at the end of August. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on the announcement and Leavitt's time in the role.

headlines.title: Nick Reiner indicted on murder charges in the death of his parents
headlines.description: Nick Reiner has been indicted on murder charges in the deaths of his parents, Rob and Michele Reiner, in a stabbing attack inside the family’s Brentwood home in December. He pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder with special circumstance allegations of multiple murders and murder by means of lying in wait, according to Los Angeles County officials. NBC News' Danny Cevallos reports.

headlines.title: Two dead after military Apache helicopter crashes near Fort Hood in Texas
headlines.description: Two people have been killed after an Apache helicopter crashed and burst into flames near Fort Hood in Texas, according to officials. NBC News' Dan De Luce reports.

headlines.title: Lindsay Clancy breaks down in court during graphic testimony on her children's autopsies
headlines.description: Lindsay Clancy broke down in court during graphic testimony on her children's autopsies. Clancy's therapist also took to the witness stand and testified that the defendant called crisis support after having "intrusive" thoughts. NBC Boston's Sue O'Connell reports.

headlines.title: Lakers to be sold to Bob Iger and Josh Kushner for $12 billion
headlines.description: The Los Angeles Lakers are being sold to an ownership group led by Josh Kushner and former Disney CEO Bob Iger reportedly for a $12.5 billion. NBC News' Steve Patterson reports on the new ownership group buying the franchise that had just been bought in late 2025.

headlines.title: Trump Addresses Elaborate Plane Swap Ruse to Keep Him Safe
headlines.description: New comments from President Donald Trump confirm that he secretly swapped planes as he left an international summit because of a threat from Iran. A U.S. official tells NBC News that the threat included the possibility of the Iranian regime targeting the president with a shoulder-fired missile. NBC’s Gabe Gutierrez reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: 3 takeaways from David Crowley’s comeback: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Two soldiers are dead after a military helicopter crashes in Texas, sparking a fire
headlines.description: Two soldiers who were on board a military helicopter were killed Wednesday when it crashed in Salado, Texas, the Bell County Sheriff’s Office said.

headlines.title: Extremism expert charged in case on Southern Poverty Law Center informants
headlines.description: “A free and fair society does not use the justice system to silence its political opponents,” Heidi Beirich’s attorney said in a statement.

headlines.title: White House press secretary Karoline Leavitt to step down
headlines.description: Leavitt, 28, is the youngest person to serve in the role. She will leave the Trump administration at the end of the month.
